blocks.text: As conditions deteriorate further, goods are bundled, movement is prepared, and enemies wait to seize both persons and property the moment Anandpur is abandoned. (26–29)
The Guru sees clearly that ordinary persuasion will not hold everyone firm, so he demands a written disclaimer from those who insist on leaving under pressure. (30–33)

The episode becomes a moral test as much as a military one: signatures are extracted, loyalties crack, and the bad time reveals how quickly attendants, servants, and nominal followers can turn away. (34)
